Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents an enrolled student in the class roster.

rollNumber.description: Unique roll number or student identification code.

fullName.description: Full legal or preferred name of the student.

gradeLevel.description: Grade, class section, or homeroom group.

contactPhone.description: Contact telephone number of student or guardian.

guardianName.description: Name of the parent or legal guardian.

avatarBgColor.description: CSS color class for the student avatar initials icon.

active.description: Whether the student is currently actively enrolled.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the student was first enrolled.

DailyAttendance.title: DailyAttendance
DailyAttendance.description: Stores classroom attendance records for a specific date.

date.description: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD for the attendance session.

records.description: Map of student IDs to their attendance status and notes.

takenBy.description: Name of the teacher or administrator taking attendance.

notes.description: Daily classroom remarks, weather notes, or announcements.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the daily record was last modified.

HealthPing.title: HealthPing
HealthPing.description: Diagnostic health ping document for connection validation.

/students/{studentId}.description: Collection of student records in the school class roster.

/attendance/{date}.description: Collection of daily attendance sheets indexed by date YYYY-MM-DD.

/_classtrack_health/{docId}.description: Health check document used to verify Firestore connectivity.
